25:       results.push(full);

28:   return results;
29: }
30: 
31: function slugFor(contentDir: string, filePath: string): string {
32:   const relative = path.relative(contentDir, filePath);
33:   const withoutExt = relative.replace(MARKDOWN_EXT, '');
34:   return withoutExt.split(path.sep).join('/');
35: }
36: 
37: function titleFor(slug: string, data: { title?: string }): string {
38:   if (data.title && data.title.trim()) {
39:     return data.title.trim();
40:   }
41:   const segments = slug.split('/').filter(Boolean);
42:   return segments[segments.length - 1] ?? slug;
43: }
44: 
45: export async function build(options: BuildOptions): Promise<Page[]> {
46:   const contentDir = path.resolve(options.content);

49:

Done. Added a live-reload dev server:

- `src/serve.ts` — `serve()` starts an HTTP server from `./dist` (default), injects a WebSocket live-reload script into served HTML, rebuilds via `build()` on chokidar change events to `content/` and `templates/`, and broadcasts `reload` to connected `ws` clients. Exports `injectLiveReload` and `liveReloadScript` for testability.
- `src/cli.ts` — added the `serve` command with `--content`, `--output`, and `--port` (default `3000`); `build` behavior is unchanged.
- `src/index.ts` — re-exports the new serve API.
- Installed `chokidar@^3.6`, `ws`, and `@types/ws` (chokidar v5 is ESM-only, incompatible with the CommonJS build).
- `tests/serve.test.ts` — new tests for injection and an end-to-end serve/rebuild/reload test.
